notes.title: Mercapolis Patch Notes 1.1 31/10/24
notes.content:
[i]A dense fog hangs over Mercopolis... The Halloween update is here![/i]

[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[]A new product has been introduced in the Central Market. Pumpkins will be available only in the autumn season and will be in high demand among customers. The purchase price will be 10, and the sale price will be 50. Happy Halloween!
[]Ghost and fog particles have been added to the autumn season during windy or rainy weather.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[]Probability of random events per day 15% > 20%
[]The maximum number of random events has been reduced from 3 to 1
[]Probability of each customer being a thief 15% > 5%
[]Customers will now leave the checkout counter if they are not attended to, but they will return the products to the shelves.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[]The trash can hitbox has been adjusted to make it easier to put out fires when it catches fire.
[]The intensity of the fight particle effect has been increased to make it clearer.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixing[/b]
[list]
[]Some English translations have been corrected.
[]The material of the electricity particle effect has been fixed to display correctly.
[]Employees will no longer get stuck in the cleaning animation when assigned another task while cleaning.
[]An error has been fixed where hiring a specialized employee would not assign them tasks until the next day.
[/list]

notes.title: Mercapolis Patch Notes 1.02 25/10/24
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Loading screen added.
[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]The data encryption method in save files has been adjusted. Now, the gameplay experience should be smoother, preventing crashes and screen freezing.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixing[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where, on the first game launch, volume levels were set to minimum.
[*]Fixed errors in the English translations of various tutorial texts.
[/list]
